say:1:1230242001:1.text: I shall quit the Carmine Whispers for my dream as a sailor.
say:1:1230242001:1.source_cn: 离开血薇帮，去追寻我船员的梦想。
say:1:1230242001:1.male: I shall quit the Carmine Whispers for my dream as a sailor.
say:1:1230242001:1.female: I shall quit the Carmine Whispers for my dream as a sailor.

say:2:1230242002:1.text: Stop trying to talk me out of it. I've heard enough.
say:2:1230242002:1.source_cn: 不必再劝说我，因为我已经听了太多的劝说。
say:2:1230242002:1.male: Stop trying to talk me out of it. I've heard enough.
say:2:1230242002:1.female: Stop trying to talk me out of it. I've heard enough.

say:3:1230242003:1.text: My choice could be wrong, but I still want to try.
say:3:1230242003:1.source_cn: 就算我的选择是错的，我也想试试。
say:3:1230242003:1.male: My choice could be wrong, but I still want to try.
say:3:1230242003:1.female: My choice could be wrong, but I still want to try.

say:4:1230242004:1.text: It isn't a big deal even if I'm wrong.
say:4:1230242004:1.source_cn: 或许就算我真的选错了，也并没有什么大不了的。
say:4:1230242004:1.male: It isn't a big deal even if I'm wrong.
say:4:1230242004:1.female: It isn't a big deal even if I'm wrong.
